results.text: In Vitro Assessment of Potential for CYP-Inhibition-Based Drug-Drug Interaction Between Vonoprazan and Clopidogrel. It was recently proposed that CYP-mediated drug-drug interactions (DDIs) of vonoprazan with clopidogrel and prasugrel can attenuate the antiplatelet actions of the latter two drugs. Clopidogrel is metabolized to the pharmacologically active metabolite H4 and its isomers by multiple CYPs, including CYP2C19 and CYP3A4. results.text: Interaction between tacrolimus and lansoprazole, but not rabeprazole in living-donor liver transplant patients with defects of CYP2C19 and CYP3A5. In case 1, a 51-year-old man with liver cirrhosis due to hepatitis C virus underwent living-donor liver transplantation, and tacrolimus was orally administered.
